findings.title: Title screen contrast
findings.problem: The orange sunset background makes the white title text hard to read, especially on lower-end displays
findings.why: Low contrast reduces readability and makes the game look unfinished
findings.fix: Darken the background or add a subtle glow/shadow to the title text to increase contrast

findings.title: Arena UI clutter
findings.problem: The condition panel overlaps the radar and health display, creating visual clutter and making it hard to see essential info at a glance
findings.why: Overlapping UI elements compete for attention and reduce situational awareness
findings.fix: Shift the condition panel slightly right or reduce its opacity when not in focus

findings.title: Road navigation feedback
findings.where: road and city screens, top center
findings.problem: The destination bar only shows remaining distance, not direction or next turn, making navigation unclear at speed
findings.why: Players need clear directional cues to avoid accidents and make quick decisions
findings.fix: Add a small compass or arrow indicating next turn direction and distance to next intersection

findings.title: City traffic clarity
findings.problem: Road markings are faint and lack clear lane divisions, making it hard to judge vehicle positions and paths
findings.why: Ambiguous road layout increases cognitive load and collision risk during fast-paced gameplay
findings.fix: Enhance road markings with brighter, more distinct lane dividers and add subtle glow to active roads

findings.title: Constructor weapon feedback
findings.problem: Empty weapon slots show '(empty)' text but lack visual differentiation from filled slots, making it hard to spot available slots
findings.why: Players need instant visual confirmation of available build options to avoid confusion
findings.fix: Use a distinct outline or placeholder icon for empty slots to clearly distinguish them from equipped weapons
